evidence_class: recorded replay of a live stream; the live capture itself (unsanitized) is private steward evidence under plans/evidence/2026-10-21-accept-1-live/
cli_version_basis: reported by the selected source (cli_version declaration); not known at launch, no version command was run
mode_and_route: CliCapture launch (opt-in integration): raw stdout, independent byte copy, flush per record
capture_command: Do these steps in order in the current directory. 1. Use the Write tool to create alpha.txt containing exactly the single line "alpha" and beta.txt containing exactly the single line "beta". 2. Read alpha.txt and beta.txt, issuing both Read tool calls in the same assistant turn. 3. Run the shell command `cat missing-file.txt` once with the Bash tool and report the exact error text. 4. Use the Task tool with subagent_type general-purpose to read beta.txt and report its content back. 5. Read alpha.txt a second time. 6. Try to change alpha.txt from "alpha" to "gamma" with the Edit tool; if the tool is not permitted, say so and do not work around it. 7. Reply with one line: "done: <content of alpha.txt> <content of beta.txt>".
scenario: feature task: two Writes, two Reads in one turn, a failing Bash, an Agent sub-agent reading a file (child core), a repeated Read, an Edit under auto permission mode; normal completion

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success

sanitization: uuid -> deterministic stand-ins by first occurrence
rate_limit_event account utilization/resetsAt -> 0 (account status is not fixture data)
privacy_review: local paths, home directory, session/thread ids, record uuids, user configuration names (agents, skills, plugins, commands, MCP servers), memory and socket paths and account rate-limit numbers replaced; tool ids, message ids, request ids and model names kept (opaque); prompt text is the deliberate synthetic task; reviewed 2026-10-21
